title: Slow Push Into Forest Cabin
tests: Tests a sustained text-specified camera push with depth and foreground parallax rather than a static image or simple zoom.

faults.what: The clip is not silent: the supplied audio report identifies an audible “Huu” vocalization and a peak of -4.1 dB.
The clip runs 6.6 seconds rather than the requested 6 seconds.

judge.summary: A convincing dawn cabin shot has clear forward movement and foreground parallax, but unwanted audio violates the explicit silence requirement.

must_haves.item: A realistic wooden cabin sits among pine trees in dawn lighting.
must_haves.why: The wooden cabin, pine forest, warm pale sky, and low mist convincingly establish the requested setting.

must_haves.item: The camera advances smoothly toward the cabin's front door throughout the six-second shot.
must_haves.why: Across the sampled frames, the cabin steadily enlarges while its front door remains near the center, consistent with a slow forward push.

must_haves.item: Foreground trees shift relative to the cabin, visibly conveying forward movement through space.
must_haves.why: Nearby trunks move outward relative to the cabin, with the closest left trunk leaving the frame, providing clear depth parallax.

must_haves.item: The cabin and trees retain consistent shapes without scene changes or cuts.
must_haves.why: The sampled frames preserve the same cabin architecture and tree arrangement, with no visible cuts or obvious morphing.

must_haves.item: The output is widescreen and silent.
must_haves.why: The images are widescreen, but the supplied audio report confirms sound, including a vocalization.
